name: Kennedy School, NE Portland -> Esther Short Park, Vancouver WA
note: The cross-river trip, run northbound on the Oregon pack because that is the pack a Portland rider has. Two bike crossings exist -- the Interstate Bridge sidewalk and the I-205 Glenn Jackson path 11 km east -- so the question is which one the router picks and what it charges.
